claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM for 5 days, this PDE4D inhibitor is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since PDE4 inhibition is cytostatic at most and no member of the screened PDE-inhibitor-like classes shows a shared killing pattern.
